user.title: Connect to a MikroTik router
user.description: Streams live throughput from the RouterOS binary API (port 8728, or 8729 with TLS).

data_description.interval: Samples arrive from the router about once a second. Over each interval the min, max and average are reported. With 1 second all three are equal.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the router.
error.invalid_auth: The router rejected the username or password.
error.router_error: The router rejected the monitor-traffic command. See the log.
error.no_interfaces: Enter at least one interface name.
error.unknown_interface: The router did not report one of these interfaces. See the log.
